model.title: A resolution designating September 25, 2026, as "National Ataxia Awareness Day", and raising awareness of ataxia, ataxia research, and the search for a cure.

summary.text: The resolution recognizes the need for greater public awareness of ataxia, a condition affecting movement and coordination, and designates September 25, 2026, as National Ataxia Awareness Day. It supports the day's goals of raising awareness of ataxia's causes and symptoms among the public and health care workers, improving diagnosis and access to care, and speeding up research toward safe and effective treatments and ultimately a cure. It also recognizes people in the United States living with ataxia and their families, and encourages states, territories, and localities to support these goals.
